purpose: Teach: 月収/出来高/同上/組合せ/既定/特約/あっせん/引き渡し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員の月収アップを目指せ
lines.en: I want to see this company raise staff salaries month over month.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clean articulation. Steady eye contact. The tone of a man stating fact, not invitation. No inflection that suggests discussion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の出来高制度を改定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll revise the commission structure for the sales team.
lines.style: Crisp, respectful acknowledgment. Slight forward lean. Quick, efficient. The response of someone used to taking notes — ready to move to the next item.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料の各項目は、同上で対応しろ
lines.en: Handle each section of the report using the same approach.
lines.style: Clipped, economical. No softening. Direct look. The kind of instruction that expects no follow-up questions. Confidence that he's been clear enough.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新メニューの組合せ案を準備しました
lines.en: Understood. I've prepared several package combinations we can propose.
lines.style: Quiet efficiency. Matter-of-fact delivery. No overselling. The tone of someone reporting readiness without seeking approval — just checking the box.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 既定の方針通り進めろ
lines.en: Proceed according to the policy we've already set.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A reminder more than an order. Steady breath. The slight patience of someone who expects this to be obvious.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様への特約条項を更新しました
lines.en: Understood. I've updated the contract terms for our key accounts.
lines.style: Steady delivery. Slight finality in the rhythm. No embellishment. The report of a task completed, understood, filed away.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業者間のあっせん料を見直せ
lines.en: Review the brokerage fees we're paying to vendors.
lines.style: Precise, businesslike. No pause. A single clear instruction. The weight of someone accustomed to being obeyed without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先との引き渡し日を確定しました
lines.en: Understood. I've confirmed the delivery dates with all our trading partners.
lines.style: Calm closure. Slight finality in pacing. Professional satisfaction without pride. The closing statement of someone tying up a loose end, ready to move forward.
